lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County Commissioners hearing four proposed Land Use Code amendments on Tuesday that would add an entirely new Natural Resources article to county code — covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations, each with its own public hearing. Also Tuesday, Town P&Z takes up the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment preliminary PUD at 860 Black Bear Rd, a Town-owned parcel where increased dimensional limits are on the table. The Telluride Hospital District board meets Wednesday with a possible action item on a Two Site Model that could reshape how and where the valley receives medical care.
